summary: Love and values merge power and transformation. This concentrated pattern asks you to use relational grace and depth with awareness.
body: Love and values merge power and transformation. This concentrated pattern asks you to use relational grace and depth with awareness. Love and value meet intensity. All-or-nothing attraction, deep desire, and a strong pull toward control in relationships. These drives sit close together, so the pattern may feel natural, immediate, and hard to separate. In practice, this can show up through love and values, power and transformation, and the choices you make when approval seeking or control starts running the room.
gift: The gift is relational grace, depth, and a more conscious way to work with love and values and power and transformation.
shadow: The shadow is approval seeking, control, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let love and values and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Magnetic and persuasive; the intensity has to be moderated.
do: Name how love and values and power and transformation are both involved
Turn relational grace and depth into one concrete choice
dont: Let approval seeking make the decision
Assume what feels natural is automatically balanced
Ignore the needs of love and values or power and transformation
